triplicateWorkloadBenchmark.description: 3 runs before vs 3 runs after, 3,000 requests per run at Concurrency 32 (70% Leaderboard Reads, 30% Submissions)
triplicateWorkloadBenchmark.machine: Apple M1 Pro (8 cores, 16.00 GB RAM)
triplicateWorkloadBenchmark.workloadAssessment: Workload difference is within normal client-side HTTP/GC variance. End-to-end API intake throughput slightly decreases by ~12% under 30% write workload due to the write-cost trade-off of maintaining the secondary index B-Tree on every submission INSERT.

queryLevelGain.heapFetches: Reduced from 1,269 blocks to 319 (Index Only Scan)

triplicateWorkloadBenchmark.writeCostTradeOff: Adding idx_submissions_covering with INCLUDE (id, authoritative_attempt_id) imposes a modest write amplification on submissions.create (~1-2 ms per insert) in exchange for cutting worker standings recalculation time by nearly half (11.12 ms to 5.88 ms), preventing worker pipeline congestion during high submission volume.

queryOptimization.targetQuery: SELECT id, contest_id, problem_id, user_id, created_at, authoritative_attempt_id FROM submissions WHERE contest_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND problem_id = $3 ORDER BY created_at ASC
queryOptimization.indexCreated: CREATE INDEX idx_submissions_covering ON submissions (contest_id, user_id, problem_id, created_at ASC) INCLUDE (id, authoritative_attempt_id)
